description: Delay-cause rows for a given year, optionally scoped to one carrier and/or one (arrival) airport, from BTS TranStats on-time data. Same fields as bts_airport_delays (arriving flights, 15+ minute-late arrivals, cancellations, diversions, delay minutes by cause) but organized by year first rather than by airport first -- use this to scan a whole year across carriers/airports, or to compare one carrier's delay profile across the airports it serves. Rows beyond `limit` are reported via truncated/total_matching rather than silently dropped -- narrow with carrier/airport or page with limit/offset to see the rest. Unknown carrier or airport codes are refused with a clear error, never an empty success.

carrier.description: Optional: 2-letter carrier code ("AA") or common name ("American").

limit.description: Max rows to return, 1-200. Default 50. A truncated response carries truncated:true and total_matching.

name: delay_causes
title: Delay Causes
